findings.title: Freeze the Controller, Defrost the Food: Uncovering Vulnerabilities in Danfoss Refrigeration Controllers
findings.summary_md: Claroty Team82 published research on August 9, 2026 identifying three vulnerabilities in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A refrigeration controller (CVE-2025-41450, CVE-2025-41451, CVE-2025-41452), including an authentication bypass via a hidden code-of-the-day mechanism and command injection through the SMTP email configuration page. The researchers demonstrated that the hidden authentication algorithm could be reconstructed to generate valid daily passwords, granting administrative access to the embedded web interface.

findings.title: Danfoss Security Advisory DSA-2025-03-01 (CVE-2025-41450)
findings.summary_md: Danfoss published a security advisory on March 24, 2025 addressing CVE-2025-41450, an improper authentication vulnerability in the AK-SM8xxA Series prior to release R4.2. The advisory notes that the authentication flaw allows an attacker capable of exploiting it to generate a web report that discloses sensitive information.

findings.title: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on the October 2026 French supermarket refrigeration attack, in which attackers remotely manipulated Danfoss controllers to force defrost cycles, causing food losses at hundreds of stores. The report notes Claroty's August disclosure and that Danfoss's advisories predated the attack by months, with no link between the disclosed flaws and the actual exploit chain confirmed at the time.
